name: LTX 2.5 — image to video + audio
description:
Upload a starting image and describe what happens next — LTX 2.5 animates it into a short video with a matching audio track. In the prompt, describe the action as it unfolds over time, the camera move, and the sounds or dialogue you want to hear (e.g. "She slowly turns her head toward the window as the camera pushes in; rain taps on the glass").

Set the width and height of the video in pixels (multiples of 64) — 1280×704 is a good 16:9 default, 704×1280 a vertical one. Your image is center-cropped to that shape, so match its orientation. Resolution, duration and frame rate drive the generation time far more than anything else, so keep clips short.

"Enhance prompt with AI" (off by default) lets a small built-in language model look at your image and expand a short prompt into a detailed cinematic one — handy for one-line prompts, but it adds a minute or two.

promptGuides.label: LTX prompting guide — Lightricks
promptGuides.tip: One flowing paragraph in the present tense (4–8 sentences) about what happens: the action in order, the camera movement and the sound, with spoken lines in "quotes". Don't re-describe what is already visible in the image.

exposedParameters.label: Prompt (motion / camera / sound)
exposedParameters.default: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The cybernetic figure slowly turns his head to the right, his glowing blue eyes scanning the horizon, mechanical joints in his neck whirring faintly. The camera follows his gaze, panning across the rooftop to reveal the city beyond: a river of light winding between dark towers, a flying vehicle gliding past between the buildings, its lights streaking. He watches it pass, then his eyes narrow slightly. The camera settles on his profile against the city glow, distant hover traffic humming, wind gusting across the rooftop. No text, no black frames.
